Find local trees with fragrant flowers and give their names in English and the home language. The language work is looking names up in a reference and pairing them across languages, which is LO-25; the drawing half has no outcome in this frame.

Make a craft item and present it to the class using the given sentence frames. A prepared spoken presentation, which LO-19 covers ('speech'); LO-20 was rejected as this is a monologue to an audience, not a conversation. Stem opens with a stray line about origami.
